h: The Table Oil and Cup in the Psalm of Trust

p: in the valley of the shadow of death,
regarding what they attributed to him
of the sin of blemishing the covenant,
for Hashem Yisbarach is with him;
and if he were, chas v'shalom,
הָא לֹא יְגוּרְךָ רָע (תְּהִלִּים ה, ה)
after all, "evil shall not dwell with You" (Tehillim 5:5)
I will merit words of Torah,
all of it refers to words of Torah."
for of words of Torah it is written
"And a healing to all his flesh";
it is called "the flesh of donkeys" (Yechezkel 23:20);
and the Torah is a healing
his intent is words of Torah,
the holiness of the third meal,
the aspect of the Name Havayah,
as is written in the holy Zohar
and so it is written in the holy Zohar
and as is expounded in the Gemara
regarding the blessing before the Torah,
"When I call the Name of Hashem, etc."
for the Torah is called the Name of Hashem.
And this is what he said,
as is written in the holy Zohar
"You have anointed my head with oil":
that is, the attribute of Atika,
"And let oil not be lacking on your head,"
for the oil is not in the head
and this corresponds to the second meal,
רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא עֵקֶב, חֵלֶק ג רעא, ב)
"the wine of the Torah she'b'al peh";
which is of the Field of Apples,
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
and this is the aspect of
"And a sage is greater than a prophet":
that it is with ruach hakodesh.
And this is what they said in the Gemara
there is no satiation in words of Torah,
will not be sated with silver,"
"One who loves Torah will not be sated."
that you learn in this world
of the World to Come, etc."
"Better for me is the Torah of Your mouth, etc.";
"And the Torah of kindness is on her tongue."
that part of Torah she'b'al peh
and its essence is for the World to Come.
"shall pursue me all the days of my life":
that the rod and the pursuits
"And I shall dwell in the house of Hashem"
that through this I will merit
"'When you walk, it will guide you' (Mishlei 6:22)
'when you lie down, it will guard you'
'and when you awake, it will converse with you'
through all the days of my life
and "length of days" in the future,

— “And the Torah is associated with light in order to say to you: Just as the light of the sun protects one forever, so too, the Torah one studies protects one forever; and it states in the previous verse with …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Mishlei 6:22 — “בהתהלכך  תנחה אתך בשכבך תשמר עליך והקיצות היא תשיחך” — “When you walk it will lead you; When you lie down it will watch over you; And when you are awake it will talk with you.”

rich.text: “בהתהלכך  תנחה אתך בשכבך תשמר עליך והקיצות היא תשיחך”
— “When you walk it will lead you; When you lie down it will watch over you; And when you are awake it will talk with you.”
